info.name: paccradle API: readiness checks the database (2026-10-29)
info.description:
Change: M1-D2, database (2026-10-29). `GET /readyz` now pings Postgres and can answer 503. Nothing else changed; probes aren't versioned, so no surface version moves. Merge into the main contract.

| Status | When | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Postgres answered within 2 s | `{ status: "ok", version }` |
| 503 | Postgres is down, refuses connections or is slower than 2 s | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `meta.dependency = "database"` |

request.description: Ready to serve requests: answers 200 only while Postgres answers within 2 s. The deploy waits for it before switching containers. `/healthz` stays a liveness check and never touches the database.
